name: albania-tourism-analytics
what_it_holds: Committed CSVs in `data/`: `arrivals_clean.csv`, `air_clean.csv`, `revenue_clean.csv`, `albania_tourism_dataset.csv` — cleaned tourism arrivals, air-transport passenger data, and tourism revenue for Albania, sourced from World Bank and Bank of Albania (quarterly). Analyzed with ML/Streamlit forecasting.
why_useful: A small but real regional-travel-volume dataset (Balkans/Southeast Europe) with quarterly Bank-of-Albania and World Bank arrivals/air-passenger/revenue series — marginal relevance to ABNB directly (Albania is not a major ABNB market) but fills the general 'regional travel volume outside US/EU' pattern (gap #7) and demonstrates a repeatable World Bank + central-bank pull others could imitate for bigger markets.

name: tourism-demand-forecast
what_it_holds: Seasonal forecasting method (method repo, not a novel dataset) for U.S. air-travel demand using public FRED series, with explicit handling of the COVID-19 structural break; claims 1.15% MAPE. MIT license.
why_useful: FRED is already a held source, but this repo is a working, tested method for building a seasonally-adjusted, structural-break-aware nowcast off FRED air-travel series — could be repurposed as a template/benchmark for our own nights/ADR structural-break handling (COVID-era discontinuities recur in many of our regressors) rather than as new data.
size_hint: Method repo, no large data files
duplicate_of_holding: FRED already held as a source; this is a method wrapper, not new data
